usageNotes: Use this before adding a new node to an existing Proxmox VE cluster — it returns the corosync link addresses, certificate fingerprints, and totem configuration that the joining node needs. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path; run it against an already-clustered node, not the node being joined. The returned `pve_fp` values must be passed verbatim to the join request to establish mutual trust.

examples.summary: Fetch join info from the default (connected) node

tips: Omit the `node` param to get info for whichever node you are connected to — the most common usage.
Use `pve_fp` from each entry in `nodelist` to verify TLS fingerprints before trusting cluster traffic.
The `totem` object reflects the live corosync totem settings; compare it against your target node's corosync.conf to catch link-count mismatches before attempting a join.
This endpoint is read-only and safe to call repeatedly — use it to audit cluster membership or confirm a node came back after maintenance.
